title: Harbinger (miniquest)
start: Talk to Navigator Jemi on the docks of Cyclosis.

steps.t: Speak to Navigator Jemi on Cyclosis (if you have just completed the Eye for an Eye miniquest you may need to relog for the chat option to show up). [Chat: 1 Harbinger miniquest. › Accept]
Travel to Tuai Leit. [Chat: Any › Any › Any]
Survive for 2 minutes. The player can simply stand there and wait.

sub.t: Repairing the hull is unnecessary as the damage dealt by the cannonballs is not enough to sink the ship in 2 minutes and Bosun Higgs repairs most of the damages for you.
White rings will indicate where the cannonballs will hit the ship. To reduce the need for food, move your character to avoid the incoming cannonballs.

steps.t: Talk to Navigator Jemi to finish.

get_inside.text: Players can unlock the ability to travel to Cyclosis by talking to Quartermaster Gully located in Port Sarim, or Menaphos, after the player has completed the quest Impressing the Locals and has completed the Cyclosis voyage within the player-owned port.
Cyclosis teleport - Players may break this teletab to teleport to the merchant district of Cyclosis. It can be purchased at Boni's Waiko Reward Shop for 5 chimes.
